welcome.arch.lead: The server generates an agnostic JSON contract. Any client — web, React, Android — can implement its own renderer.
welcome.arch.title: Client-Agnostic by design
welcome.comm.lead: Share code, ask questions and collaborate with other USIM developers.
welcome.comm.title: Join the conversation
welcome.comp.label: Text labels, headings, paragraphs
welcome.comp.lead: All builders use a fluent API based on UIComponent and Container, with common styling and behavior methods.
welcome.comp.title: Component Library
welcome.feat.auth.desc: Login, register, password recovery, profiles and role management with Sanctum and Spatie Permission included.
welcome.feat.auth.title: Full Auth
welcome.feat.delta.desc: The framework diffs old vs new state and sends only the changes to the client — minimal payload, maximum efficiency.
welcome.feat.delta.title: Delta Updates
welcome.feat.events.desc: Automatic naming convention for event handlers. Buttons, forms and actions wire themselves to the correct handler.
welcome.feat.events.title: Event System
welcome.feat.octane.desc: Compatible with long-running processes. Automatic ID generator reset per request — no extra config needed.
welcome.feat.octane.title: Octane / RoadRunner
welcome.feat.serverui.desc: Define your entire interface in PHP. Screens, menus, forms, tables and modals — no JavaScript required.
welcome.feat.serverui.title: Server-Driven UI
welcome.feat.testing.desc: Guides and helpers for screen testing with clear patterns, component assertions and AI-agent test generation support.
welcome.feat.testing.title: Integrated Testing
welcome.features.lead: A new paradigm where the server controls the UI and the client only renders the result.
welcome.features.title: Why USIM?
welcome.footer.copy: © 2026 Institute of Informatics · FCEFyN · MIT License
welcome.hero.desc: USIM is a Server-Driven UI framework for Laravel. Define screens, forms, tables and modals in PHP — the framework handles rendering, diffing and updating everything on the client automatically.
welcome.install.label: Install via Composer:
welcome.inst.lead: USIM is a project born from academic and research environments in software engineering.
welcome.inst.title: Developed with the support of
welcome.inst1.desc: Faculty of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences. Institution of excellence in technological research and development.
welcome.inst1.name: Institute of Informatics
welcome.inst2.desc: Applied research in gamification and user experiences oriented to motivation and learning.
welcome.inst2.name: Gamification Engineering Laboratory
welcome.inst3.desc: USIM is completely free and open source under the MIT license. Use it, modify it and distribute it freely.
welcome.inst3.name: MIT License · Free Software
